MikroTik 2.5in SATA 64GB SSD Legacy x86 RouterOS 64bit License Level 6

The MikroTik 2.5in SATA 64GB SSD Legacy x86 RouterOS 64bit License (Pre-Install) Level 6 is a high-performance storage solution designed specifically for MikroTik routers. This 2.5-inch SATA solid-state drive (SSD) provides a reliable and fast data storage solution with a capacity of 64GB, offering ample space for managing various routing tasks and applications. With its robust build and compatibility, this SSD is ideal for use in MikroTik's PC-based machines as well as other supported server systems. One of the key features of this SSD is its Legacy BIOS Boot Mode, ensuring seamless integration with older hardware configurations. It is pre-installed with RouterOS v6.48, providing a stable platform for network management, and it also supports future updates, including the latest v6.49.14 version, ensuring your system stays up-to-date with MikroTik's enhancements and security patches. The SSD’s 64-bit RouterOS License (Level 6) grants access to advanced networking features, including the ability to run multiple complex routing protocols, VPNs, and firewall configurations, making it an excellent choice for both small and medium-sized network deployments. The MikroTik SSD supports various storage capacities, ranging from 16GB to 128GB, allowing you to select the option that best suits your needs. This flexible capacity range means you can scale your system depending on the requirements of your network infrastructure. Additionally, the product includes technical support and warranty, ensuring peace of mind during its usage. This combination of high performance, reliability, and support makes the MikroTik 2.5in SATA 64GB SSD a great investment for anyone seeking to enhance the capabilities of their MikroTik RouterOS-powered network systems.

MikroTik Legacy x86 RouterOS 64bit License Features

  • 2.5in SATA Solid State Drive
  • Legacy BIOS Boot Mode
  • Build with PC Mikrotik Machine
  • Supported Server Mikrotik Machine
  • Capacity Available: 16GB / 32GB /64GB/ 128GB
  • OS Version Update and Downgrade Support
  • OS Version v6.48 Pre-Install
  • OS Version v6.49.14 Update
  • Technical and Warranty Support
